evidences.description: Gauss Prime has a variety of abilities that deal damage, including Mach Rush, Thermal Sunder, and Redline.
His Kinetic Plating ability can convert kinetic damage into energy, providing additional offensive capabilities.

scores.reasoning: Gauss Prime is highly effective in dealing damage through his various abilities. His battery system allows him to charge up for powerful attacks, making him a formidable combatant.

evidences.description: Gauss Prime has Kinetic Plating, which provides damage resistance and protection from being staggered or knocked down.
His shield recharges faster while moving, providing additional survivability in combat.

scores.reasoning: While Gauss Prime is not the most survivable Warframe due to his reliance on battery management, he does have some built-in protections that help him endure longer in battles.

evidences.description: Gauss Prime has limited support abilities compared to other Warframes.
His Kinetic Plating can provide some utility by converting damage into energy.

scores.reasoning: Gauss Prime's primary focus is on dealing damage and self-preservation rather than providing direct support to allies.

His Mach Rush ability can knock down enemies and create a shockwave.

scores.reasoning: While Gauss Prime does have some crowd control abilities, they are limited compared to other Warframes. His primary focus is on dealing damage rather than controlling the battlefield.

evidences.description: Gauss Prime has no stealth-related abilities.
His abilities are primarily focused on combat and self-preservation.

evidences.description: Gauss Prime has a complex battery system that requires careful management.
His abilities are multi-step processes that require precise timing and execution.

data.summary: Gauss Prime is a highly effective damage dealer with a focus on self-preservation. He has limited support and crowd control capabilities, but excels in combat through his battery system and multi-step abilities. His complexity lies in managing his battery and executing precise timing for optimal performance.
